summary: First full run. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (public events/projects, booking validation/duplicate 409/capacity full 400, member register/409/privacy 422, set-password via DB-inserted token, member dashboard incl. bookings matched by email (case-insensitive), admin toggles enrollment/fee/card -> in_good_standing, fee year validation, contacts is_member, change-password, logout, member delete, admin event CRUD (end<start 400), project CRUD (highlights), admin self-register domain 400 / unverified 403 / verify-email single-use / login after verify, bcrypt $2b$, httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookies, CORS explicit origin + credentials, brute force 5x401 then 429, 401 on admin without auth, 403 member on /api/admin/*). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390): all public routes + 404 render with correct titles/h1; navbar links + Accesso dropdown (login/registrazione links) work; mobile toggle/panel/links work and close on navigation, no horizontal overflow; booking form required validation, success state, duplicate -> booking-error; /diventa-socio privacy required, membership-success, duplicate error; admin-register frontend domain error + success; unverified admin login shows 403 message; verify-email page success then login -> /admin; admin dashboard stats; Soci toggles change badge Non in regola -> In regola; detail modal notes persist (verified in DB), year chips, delete with confirm; filters; Interessati list; Events create/edit/delete via modal with datetime-local (local time preserved 18:30), bookings modal; Projects create/edit/delete, highlights one-per-line (blank lines stripped), visible on /progetti; set-password page (mismatch blocked, invalid token error, missing token message) -> login -> /area-socio shows tessera card, all status badges, fees list, bookings list; change password + re-login with new password; route guards redirect to /accesso?redirect=...; member hitting /admin redirected to /area-socio; logout clears session (/api/auth/me 401). No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: Emergent email API returned 429 'rate_limited' after a burst of ~8 sends during testing; all subsequent sends in the session failed (email_sent=false). App degrades gracefully (UI shows 'non siamo riusciti a inviare l'email'), but there is no retry/backoff and 'rate_limited' is logged as a generic failure. Consider a small retry with backoff for 429.

try_send_email only catches HTTPException; _assert_safe_email raises ValueError, which would surface as 500 AFTER the booking/member row was already committed (user sees error but record exists). Catch ValueError too (log + return False).
next_membership_number uses SELECT max+1 with no lock; two concurrent registrations can collide on unique membership_number -> unhandled IntegrityError 500. Use a sequence or retry on IntegrityError.

Re-registering an existing UNVERIFIED @giguiya.it admin overwrites its name/password without any check (anyone can reset a pending admin's password). Low risk since email verification still required, but consider rejecting or only re-sending the link.
Refresh tokens are stateless JWT (7+ days); logout only clears cookies, a stolen refresh token stays valid until expiry. Acceptable for MVP.

Logo subtitle 'ASSOCIAZIONE · TORINO' wraps onto two lines next to the 'Diventa socio' pill; header feels cramped
Mobile panel background is slightly translucent during fadeUp; hero heading visible behind menu items

Names displayed 'Cognome Nome' (e.g. 'Booker TEST_Ui') while member detail modal shows 'Nome Cognome' - inconsistent ordering

action_items: Add retry/backoff for email 429 rate_limited responses (optional) and catch ValueError in try_send_email to avoid 500 after commit
Optional: dynamic page titles for event/project detail; tidy mobile header at 390px; admin top bar alignment

Tests create set_password/verify_email tokens by inserting sha256(raw) into auth_tokens via psql. Email API may be rate-limited (429) after bursts - bookings/registrations still succeed with email_sent=false. rca of the issue: Email failures during the run: backend log shows 'Email send failed: 429 {"code":"rate_limited"}' from integrations.emergentagent.com after rapid sends from the test suite - external rate limit, not an app bug.
